profile: I based these on your recent work: the UpperHand Workbench and standards-based multi-agent coordination, the Org Age of AI thesis and its three tracks (data, software, cooperation), and your trust and verification work with clients. I favored talks with real deployment evidence over product demos. Where talks run in parallel I gave one GO per slot. I don't know your ticket type, so check whether workshops are open to you. Talks with no published abstract are judged on the speaker alone, and the reason says so.
